carriedForwardOpenQuestions.text: None. The topic is two-part and both parts are answered with cited evidence.

keyFindings.text: `implementation-summary.md` is the packet file that documents the deep-research reducer's `--artifact-dir` flag and its behavior: line 52 states "The deep-research reducer takes `--artifact-dir <path>`, the same flag the deep-review reducer already had"; line 81 records the design decision "Exit 1 when `--artifact-dir` has no value. The research reducer already uses exit 1 for usage errors; review uses 3"; line 93 records the verification row "Missing flag value | PASS, exit 1 with `[deep-research] --artifact-dir requires a path value`". [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/038-review-and-cli-lineage/006-research-lineage-reducer-path/implementation-summary.md:52,81,93]

A missing value produces exit code 1, confirmed in the reducer source: after locating `--artifact-dir`, the CLI tests whether the next token is absent or begins with `--`, writes `[deep-research] --artifact-dir requires a path value` to stderr, and calls `process.exit(1)`; the space-separated value is excluded from positionals so it cannot be misread as the spec folder. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:3151,3152,3153,3154,3155,3156,3159]

The packet docs and the reducer source agree, including the one documented limitation: `implementation-summary.md:106` says the equals form `--artifact-dir=<path>` "is dropped with other `--` tokens and the reducer falls back to the base folder", which matches the source's space-only `args.indexOf('--artifact-dir')` lookup (line 3151) and its positional filter that drops every token starting with `--` (line 3159); the `artifactDir` option itself resolves an explicit folder when given and falls back to `resolveArtifactRoot(...).artifactDir` otherwise (lines 2955-2957). [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/038-review-and-cli-lineage/006-research-lineage-reducer-path/implementation-summary.md:106; .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:2942,2955,2956,2957,3151,3159]

Three other packet files specify or track the flag but do not document its behavior: `spec.md:71` lists it in scope ("`--artifact-dir <path>` on the deep-research reducer CLI and an `artifactDir` option on `reduceResearchState`"), with the deliverable at `spec.md:46` and success criterion SC-001 at `spec.md:114`; `plan.md:29` names the change and `plan.md:61` describes the binding ("The bind step turns that into `--artifact-dir <folder>`"); `tasks.md:43` (T003) records the delegation and `tasks.md:44` (T004) records "missing value exits 1 with `--artifact-dir requires a path value`". No packet file is a dedicated reducer CLI reference; the flag is documented across these four files, and only `implementation-summary.md` (plus the T004 task row) states the missing-value exit code. [SOURCE: specs/system-deep-loop/038-review-and-cli-lineage/006-research-lineage-reducer-path/spec.md:46,71,114; specs/system-deep-loop/038-review-and-cli-lineage/006-research-lineage-reducer-path/plan.md:29,61; specs/system-deep-loop/038-review-and-cli-lineage/006-research-lineage-reducer-path/tasks.md:43,44]
